directions.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: one finished macOS app icon for Research Workbench, an academic's local app for networked AI systems, network security, code and research papers. User rejected green node logos and a bulky blue/silver 3D interwoven triangular knot. Make a totally different design, visually sophisticated, memorable, extremely simple, with calm generous negative space and precise optical balance. Flat vector logo rendering, broad smooth geometry, maximum three solid colors, no gradients on the symbol, no bevel, emboss, metallic sheen, 3D sculpture, shiny plastic, texture, noise, shadows, interlocking ribbons, knots, multicolor dots, generic AI brain, shield, atom, chemistry flask, tiny circuits, spaghetti wires, extra decorative details, words or watermark. No green, teal, turquoise, mint or olive anywhere. One centered icon only, not a mockup or presentation board. Outside the rounded-square tile must be transparent. Tile approximately 88% of the square image; symbol approximately 55% of tile width, very legible at 32 pixels. Output a crisp production-ready square icon. Direction: editorial, intelligent, human. A warm ivory rounded-square tile (#F4F1EB). A single sculpted midnight-ink emblem built from two offset abstract paper planes and a short clean branching path, integrating paper research and network structure into ONE elegant geometric silhouette. One tiny cobalt accent can mark the path's terminal. Avoid a literal file/document outline and avoid a stack of documents clipart. Think of a beautifully designed scientific publishing imprint, with asymmetric balance and striking negative space. Use ink #20242C, ivory, and cobalt #4361EE only.
